{{Top|leg}}
The '''Imperial Information Committee''' was a sub-branch of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence's]] [[Media (Imperial Intelligence)|Media]] branch. It relayed events and updates on the status of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to its military personnel.
